_comment: Providers whose status pages we watch (poll.py), and what of each we use. type statuspage = Atlassian Statuspage JSON (summary.json: components, incidents, scheduled maintenance); type rss = a status page's RSS history (category incident|maintenance, newest update's state). An item is `direct` when it names a component we use (statuspage) or when it is not marked as outside what we use (rss: a title matching other_title, or text matching other_text); else `other`. Hetzner and Cloudflare have their own collectors (infra/hetzner-status, infra/cloudflare-edge).

github.name: GitHub
github._why: Git Operations: pushes, pulls, the fleets' checkouts; API Requests: gh, the fleets, the hub's fleet queue; Actions: CI, deploys, drills; Pull Requests and Issues: the fleets, reviews; Packages: ghcr.io, prod's images; Pages: the docs sites. Not Copilot or Codespaces.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter._why: We use the API (inference): the fleets, the assistant's assistant-cloud failover, the podcast pipeline, the eval keys. Its feed names no components, so an item counts as ours unless its title is about the website, sign-in or video, or its text says inference is not affected.
